title: fix(macos): restore Gateway accent after clearing Talk profile color
body:
Related: #185529

## What Problem This Solves

Native Mac chat can keep the old personal color (or theme default) after a personal accent is cleared if Talk Mode has loaded its configuration.

## User Impact

Clearing a personal accent restores the Gateway-wide accent without requiring another Gateway configuration change. Talk and native chat continue to use the same effective appearance. Public configuration, shared SDK APIs, and the `talk.config` wire response are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

`talk.config` returns a personally resolved `ui.seamColor`; storing it in the app's Gateway-wide fallback mixes two different meanings. Following #185529, ControlChannel already refreshes Gateway appearance independently of Talk.

Remove Talk's competing state write, unused accent field, and parser. Keep ControlChannel as the sole writer. Extend the existing connection-boundary regression instead of adding another fixture. Simplification: production +2/-12 lines; tests +24/-18 lines, net -4 overall. No new state, options, or compatibility paths.

## Evidence

- Native test-bundle compilation passes: `swift build --package-path apps/macos --build-system native --build-tests`.
- Red/green proof exercises the real ControlChannel and TalkModeRuntime through the existing in-memory WebSocket transport: receive Gateway appearance, load `talk.config`, clear the personal preference through `users.prefs.changed`, and assert the effective native-chat accent without another `config.changed`.
- On base `79d467a82ca886ee9a9051b8cb155d401ef134c0` with the extended regression, the color case resolves to `#123456` instead of `#aa0000`, and the explicit-theme case resolves to nil instead of `#aa0000`. The no-profile case passes. Test time: 0.028 seconds.
- With the fix, all three cases pass. Test time: 0.025 seconds.
- All 7 remaining TalkModeGatewayConfigTests pass (0.001 seconds).
- Execution uses the compiled SwiftPM test helper under an audited macOS OS sandbox, with private home/config/state and a clean environment. Negative preflight verifies operator-file, preferences/Keychain IPC, desktop-service, network, and unapproved child-execution denial. This is native production-boundary proof, not a packaged-app run.
- Targeted SwiftLint: all four changed files, zero violations. Production-file pinned SwiftFormat and `git diff --check` pass. An accidentally broadened lint invocation also found existing size-limit violations in untouched sources; no unrelated source or limits were changed.
- Independent source review found no actionable issues. Local ClawSweeper committed-range review completed with no correctness or security findings for `79d467a82ca886ee9a9051b8cb155d401ef134c0..e01bdbfd7347a851493712301a8fee540b79f0d5`. It reviewed source only; the test execution above was performed separately.
- [Ordinary PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41957646300) completed successfully at 2026-11-05 02:52:57 UTC for head `267844706091fdcc8482f0cb11c5beec741878f0`. Actual checkout was GitHub's merge commit `036fab12d2d9509744c182c5840b1979ddf5e874`, merging that head into `742b5144d391da0d5523291936a3c9b197350554`. Preflight, security-fast, native-i18n, and the CI gate passed. Both macos-swift jobs were unselected and skipped; this is not Swift build/test CI proof. The manifest intentionally excludes ordinary pull requests from `runMacos`, and `runMacosSwift` depends on that selection (`scripts/ci-build-manifest.mjs`).

### Remaining proof

Packaged-app before/after screenshots and exact-head Swift CI remain outstanding despite the green ordinary PR gate.

- [Manual CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41956591567) failed during manifest generation, before product tests. Logs confirm checkout/target `267844706091fdcc8482f0cb11c5beec741878f0` and validation tier `main`, but workflow revision `742b5144d391da0d5523291936a3c9b197350554`. The planner rejects this combination: "The main validation tier requires canonical same-revision manual or scheduled validation with full scope". Both macos-swift jobs were skipped; this run provides no Swift CI proof and does not establish a product failure. No duplicate manual run was dispatched.
- GitHub records @RomneyDa marking this PR ready for review at 2026-11-05 02:49:08 UTC; that external state change is not evidence that the remaining proof is complete.
- Packaged-app capture still needs a qualified clean macOS account or VM; the available local VM is Windows. No live Talk overlay, microphone/audio, real-Gateway, or screenshot result is claimed. The screenshots on #185529 establish its chat-only fix, not this follow-up's Talk/profile-clear interaction.
